bibl.title: In margine al papiro cairense n. 65445: una rilettura tra storia e archeologia.
bibl.seg: Elena Santagati, In margine al papiro cairense n. 65445: una rilettura tra storia e archeologia.
bibl.note: P. Cair. Inv. 65445 (= MP3 2642; LDAB 1054), 140-154. - The origin of the marble, the function and the location of the original structure are interpreted as indicators of a historical and economic context of the Ptolemaic kingdom in the second quarter of the third century B.C.
